extraction.Name: Mollie Janis
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, in fact did not know much about it and did not realize what she was doing when she signed the receipt, but did it on the advice of the Farmer who told her that she must take the patent, pay the taxes or lose the land
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold the land to H. A. Dawson for $160.00 in cash and the rest in trade in the store, and he paid the taxes
extraction.Buyer: H. A. Dawson; she does not know just how much she received but thinks it is over $2000.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so she sold the land
extraction.Occupation/Income: does washing for a living when she is able to work
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in very poor health; has nothing and no home; has a very hard time and does not think she can last much longer; has no one to support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since her patent was issued; document reference No. 1783; possible allotment reference 2044 noted at bottom of document | TASK 5 CAT_3 BACKFILL 2026-05-04 (patents database): Allotment 1783 sourced from federal-register-app patents database (Christian's research, 2026-05-04).
